name: Introduction | Canvas UI
summary: Docs introduction to Canvas UI, an open source library of canvas effects components with WebGL and WebGPU builds.
description: Canvas UI renders real HTML inside a canvas element with GPU effects (WebGL or WebGPU) running over it, so the content underneath stays interactive. Every component ships in six flavors — React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte and vanilla TypeScript — and is distributed through a shadcn registry that drops the source into your project. Effects include fluid simulations, shaders and other visual experiments.
contains: components in six flavors: React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte, vanilla TypeScript
every effect has WebGL and WebGPU builds with the same public API
effects render over live HTML via the html-in-canvas API
named effects include Liquid, Asciify, Glyph Rain, Glass, Glitch, Droplets, Cloth, Frost and Laser
